 Bigg Boss 20’s ‘rockstar’ Qazi Touqeer says he is ‘very loyal’ to his dentist wife. Who is his partner Ifsa?
 SECTIONS Bigg Boss 20’s ‘rockstar’ Qazi Touqeer says he is ‘very loyal’ to his dentist wife. Who is his partner Ifsa? ET Online Last Updated: Oct 24, 2026, 02:54:00 PM IST Rate Story Follow us Share Font Size Abc Small Abc Medium Abc Large Save Print Comment Synopsis Qazi Touqueer ended all speculations on his lovelife recently. The singer said that he is very loyal to his wife, Ifsa, and said that she was nine years younger, a dentist and a great cook to boot!
 Agencies Who is Qazi Touqeer's wife? Qazi Touqeer has been winning hearts across the country since he became a participant in Bigg Boss 20. There has also been plenty of speculation regarding Qazi’s love life. However, recently, the singer set the record straight - he is a happily married man. In a chat with his housemates, the singer talked about his wife, Ifsa. Ifsa is nine years younger than him and works as a dentist. In a conversation with a housemate, Gullu said his wife was nine years younger and made delicious mirchi korma .
 He also asserted his loyalty to his wife. He asked Gullu to deliver a message to his wife. Gullu decided to be a bit mischievous and said, "Bhabiji, namaste. Bhabi, your man is a good man. Sometimes he becomes a naughty man. But he likes to be around girls…”
Qazi decided to set the record straight. He said all the women in the Bigg Boss house are like his daughters. He stated, "My wife knows me. I am very very loyal.” 
Not much is known about his wife, although one X user claimed to have found her Instagram and shared one post from her alleged Instagram handle on the microblogging platform. It shared an art of the singer and his wife, and she wrote an adoring post on how she believed in her husband’s talents and potential.
“My dear husband, This is your time to rock, shine, and conquer the world. I believe in your vision, your calibre, and your incredible ability to make the impossible possible. I wish you angel wings to fly, endless strength to rise, and may you be showered with immense love, care, and blessings,” the note reads.
Despite all the adulation he has received as a participant in Bigg Boss 20 and winning the singing show Fame Gurukul in 2005, the singer has not been able to make a mark in the industry. Qazi, who is from Kashmir , became Fame Gurukul’s most popular contestant and eventually emerged victorious. Despite his unique voice and impeccable looks, Qazi’s career never really took off – either as an actor or a singer. He was cast in a film called Take Off, which was meant to be his debut venture, but it was never released.
